title: Ultimate Backup
summary: Easy-to-use file storage. Supports both Ultimate Backup SSD and 4-in-1 drives.
description:
Mobile Backup Simplified.

Whether you run out of space or get a new phone, backing up your precious memories from your phone is important and makes room to keep creating new ones! Keep your photos, videos, music, and contacts safe and secure with the Ultimate Backup family of products.

• On-The-Go - A must during travel, Ultimate Backup can be used anytime and anywhere.

• Free up Space - Backup your current device to Ultimate Backup then delete the photos and videos off your phone to make room for more, knowing they are safe & secure on your Ultimate Backup!

• Compatible - Ultimate Backup works on most mobile and desktop platforms. Ultimate Backup recognizes each device and knows where each backup left off making it easy to share with the whole family.

• Secure - With a portable backup device, your files are always kept private and protected.

• Convenient - Want to show someone pictures from your computer or another device? Just plug your Ultimate Backup drive in to view, manage, and share those files!

• Backup & Restore - Do you have an old phone with tons of awesome pictures and videos or maybe your phone broke and you need a new one? Easily transfer your photos, videos and contacts from one device to another with Ultimate Backup.

* Some features vary depending no the type of Ultimate backup drive you own.
